key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: Ordered list of desktop IDs pinned to the top panel. Duplicates are removed, keeping the first occurrence.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which panel box the app icons are placed in: 'left', 'center' or 'right'.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Non-negative index within the selected panel box.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Logical icon size in pixels, between 16 and 32.

key.name: show-running-indicator
key.description: Whether to show a subtle indicator when an application is running.

key.name: max-visible-apps
key.description: Maximum number of app icons shown before an overflow menu is used, between 1 and 20.
